metadata.title: Sandwich ELISA (quantitative capture immunoassay)
metadata.purpose: Quantify a soluble antigen by capturing it between a plate-bound capture antibody and a biotinylated detection antibody, developing with streptavidin-HRP + TMB, and interpolating concentration from a standard curve read at 450 nm.
metadata.scope: Colorimetric matched-pair (capture + biotinylated detection) sandwich ELISA in a 96-well high-binding plate, biotin/streptavidin-HRP detection, TMB substrate, absorbance readout. The in-repo teaching PDF (src1) is actually an INDIRECT ELISA (antigen adsorbed directly, then primary + HRP secondary); it grounds only the shared buffer recipes (carbonate coating buffer pH 9.6, PBS pH 7.4, PBS-T, 2 M H2SO4 stop) and 37 degC incubation convention. The sandwich architecture, antibody dilutions, and timings come from the published sandwich-ELISA protocol (src2). Not validated here for competitive or direct-ELISA formats.
metadata.estimatedTime: ~1 day active over 2 sessions (overnight capture-antibody coat, then ~4-5 h assay)
beforeYouBegin: Select a validated matched antibody pair (capture + biotinylated detection) and a recombinant antigen standard for the target of interest; these are target-specific and not fixed by this protocol.
Prepare coating buffer (carbonate-bicarbonate pH 9.6), PBS (pH 7.4), and wash buffer PBS-T (PBS + 0.05% Tween-20) as in Materials.
Plan the plate layout: standards (7-point + blank) in duplicate and unknown samples in duplicate; see the plate-layout table.

materials.name: Capture antibody (matched pair)
materials.specification: Target-specific capture antibody; adsorbed to the plate. Exact antibody/target and RRID are assay-specific and not fixed by this protocol.
materials.rawText: Dilute the capture antibody in coating buffer (Na2CO3 / NaHCO3, pH 9.6) to the manufacturer's recommended concentration (typically 1-4 ug/mL)

materials.name: Coating buffer (carbonate-bicarbonate, pH 9.6)
materials.specification: Na2CO3 0.15 g + NaHCO3 0.293 g, add H2O to 100 mL (pH 9.6)
materials.rawText: Coating buffer (Carbonate-Bicarbonate buffer, pH 9.6): Na2CO3 0.15 g, NaHCO3 0.293 g, add H2O to 100 mL (pH 9.6).

materials.name: PBS (phosphate-buffered saline, pH 7.4)
materials.specification: NaCl 8.0 g, KCl 0.20 g, KH2PO4 0.24 g, Na2HPO4.12H2O 2.9 g, add H2O to 1000 mL (pH 7.4)
materials.rawText: Phosphate buffered saline (PBS): NaCl 8.0 g, KCl 0.20 g, KH2PO4 0.24 g, Na2HPO4.12 H2O 2.9 g, add H2O to 1000 mL (pH 7.4).

materials.name: Blocking buffer
materials.rawText: 1% BSA in PBS, or commercial blocker

materials.name: Recombinant antigen standard
materials.specification: Target antigen at a known stock concentration, used to build the standard curve. Identity and stock concentration are assay-specific.

materials.name: Biotinylated detection antibody (matched pair)
materials.specification: Target-specific detection antibody, biotin-conjugated; second arm of the matched pair.

materials.name: TMB substrate
materials.specification: 3,3',5,5'-tetramethylbenzidine / H2O2 single-component substrate; produces blue product oxidized by HRP.
materials.rawText: 90 uL substrate; 10-20 min at 37 C in the dark

materials.name: Stop solution (2 M H2SO4)
materials.specification: 2 M sulfuric acid; converts blue TMB product to yellow.
materials.hazard: Corrosive; wear gloves and eye protection.

samples.name: Antigen standard-curve series (7-point + blank)
samples.description: 2-fold serial dilutions of the recombinant antigen standard used to build the calibration curve; includes a diluent-only blank.

samples.name: Test sample (unknown antigen)
samples.description: Serum, plasma, cell-culture supernatant, or lysate containing the antigen at unknown concentration. Matrix and required dilution are sample-specific.

samples.name: OD450 dataset / interpolated concentrations
samples.description: Per-well absorbance at 450 nm and antigen concentrations interpolated from the 4-PL standard curve.

tables.title: Standard-curve dilution series (7-point, 2-fold)
tables.note: Absolute concentrations depend on the recombinant antigen standard stock (m6), which the source does not specify (needsReview). Source states a 7-point standard curve; a 2-fold serial dilution is the standard convention shown here.

tables.title: Plate layout (conventional example)
tables.note: Conventional arrangement (NOT specified by either source): columns 1-2 hold the standard curve in duplicate (S1 top -> S7, blank in row H); columns 3-12 hold unknown samples in duplicate. Adapt to the number of samples and required replicates.

steps.action: Dilute capture antibody in coating buffer and coat the plate; incubate to allow adsorption.
steps.expectedResult: Capture antibody adsorbed to well surface.

steps.action: Block remaining binding sites with blocking buffer.
Prepare the 7-point 2-fold standard-curve dilution series plus a diluent blank.
Add standards and samples to wells per the plate layout; incubate to allow antigen capture.
steps.criticalNotes: Load standards and unknowns in duplicate; include the diluent blank.

steps.action: Add biotinylated detection antibody and incubate.
steps.expectedResult: Detection antibody bound to captured antigen.
HRP localized to captured antigen via biotin-streptavidin.

parameters.rawText: Final wash: 5x with 300 uL per well

steps.action: Add TMB substrate and develop in the dark.

parameters.rawText: 10-20 min at 37 C in the dark

steps.expectedResult: Blue color develops in positive wells.
steps.criticalNotes: Protect from light; monitor development to avoid saturation.

steps.action: Stop the reaction with 2 M H2SO4.
steps.expectedResult: Color turns from blue to yellow.

steps.action: Read absorbance at 450 nm and interpolate sample concentrations from the standard curve.
steps.expectedResult: OD450 per well; 4-PL curve fit; interpolated antigen concentrations.

controls.name: Standard curve
controls.description: 7-point recombinant antigen dilution series for quantitative interpolation (4-PL fit).

controls.name: Blank (diluent only)
controls.description: No-antigen well to define background/zero absorbance.

controls.name: No-detection-antibody control
controls.description: Omit biotinylated detection antibody to detect non-specific streptavidin-HRP/substrate signal.

expectedOutputs: A 4-parameter-logistic standard curve relating OD450 to antigen concentration.
Interpolated antigen concentrations for each unknown sample (mean of replicates).

troubleshooting.cause: Insufficient blocking or washing; conjugate too concentrated
troubleshooting.solution: Extend blocking; add washes; titrate detection antibody / streptavidin-HRP

troubleshooting.cause: Mismatched antibody pair; degraded substrate; capture antibody too dilute
troubleshooting.solution: Confirm the matched pair; use fresh TMB; increase coating concentration

troubleshooting.cause: Pipetting error in serial dilution; edge effects
troubleshooting.solution: Prepare dilutions carefully; run standards in duplicate; avoid edge wells or add plate lid

safety: 2 M H2SO4 stop solution is corrosive - wear gloves and eye protection.
TMB substrate is an irritant; handle per SDS and dispose of per institutional rules.
Human/animal sample matrices may be biohazardous - handle at the appropriate biosafety level.
limitations: The in-repo source PDF (src1) is an indirect ELISA, so only its shared buffer recipes and 37 degC / 2 M H2SO4 conventions are grounded here; the sandwich architecture, antibody dilutions, incubation times, TMB substrate, and 450 nm readout come from src2. The specific matched antibody pair, antigen standard identity and absolute standard concentrations, and sample dilutions are assay-specific and marked needsReview. Plate layout (t2) is a conventional example, not taken from a source.
